hooks.command: f=$(python -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path') or '')" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in {{SOURCE_GLOB}}) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; l=$({{HOOK_LINT_CMD}} 2>&1); lrc=$?; t=""; trc=0; {{HOOK_TYPECHECK_BLOCK}} if [ $lrc -ne 0 ] || [ $trc -ne 0 ]; then { echo "$l"; echo "$t"; } >&2; exit 2; fi
